sources.title: PDF CellBRIDGE: Learning Cellular Trajectories via Interaction-Aware Alignment
sources.snippet: CellBRIDGE. From an LR catalogue, we build directed CCI matrices. A structure-aware OT problem balances 175 feature similarity with interaction structure to produce snapshot couplings used to train a vector field to recover cell trajectories.
